name: WEWORK INDIA MANAGEMENT L
summary: WeWork India Management Limited engages in management and leasing of office buildings to large enterprises, small and mid-size businesses, startups, and individuals In India. Its services include private custom-designed workspaces, standard private offices, coworking spaces offices, office suites, serviced floors, and managed offices; and conference room rental, printing, charges, parking, etc. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
